Execute a query in a DuckDB session.

This endpoint dispatches query execution to the job worker queue and polls
for completion. The query is executed within a DuckDB session with proper
authentication and authorization.

The endpoint is synchronous for backward compatibility - it waits for the
query to complete before returning. For long-running queries, consider
the async execution pattern (future enhancement).

get.description:
Get query execution history for a session.

Returns a list of all queries executed in the specified session,
with pagination support. The project_id query parameter is required
for authorization.

Declared sync so FastAPI runs the blocking history lookup in its
threadpool instead of blocking the event loop.

post.description:
Initialize a query session and wait for the initialization job to finish.

This endpoint dispatches an InitializeSessionJob to the Python worker queue,
then blocks until the job completes or the wait times out. The job creates
the DuckDB session, loads catalog metadata, creates storage connections,
and sets up external tables for data querying.

Returns a SessionInitResponse containing the updated session when
initialization succeeds. A job_run_id may also be returned for traceability.
If the initialization times out or fails, the response includes an
error_message describing the outcome.

get.description:
Get a specific query session by ID.

Returns detailed information about a single query session.
The project_id query parameter is required for authorization.

patch.description:
Update a query session.

Allows updating session properties like name, status, and metadata.
The project_id query parameter is required for authorization.

Users can only update their own sessions (user-level isolation).
Administrators can update any session, including changing status to Closed.

delete.description:
Delete a query session.

Permanently removes a query session and dispatches an async job to delete
the associated database file. The project_id query parameter is required
for authorization.

Users can only delete their own sessions (user-level isolation).

ChartConfig.title: ChartConfig
ChartConfig.description: Flat chart configuration object: set `chartType` (line, bar, column, area, pie, scatter, dualAxes, funnel, heatmap, histogram, box, radar, stock) and the kind's field keys, in camelCase (xField/yField — never x/y shorthand, never a {bar: {...}} wrapper). Common keys: chartType, title, height (required for every kind), then the kind's required field keys: line/bar/column/area/scatter/funnel/heatmap/box/radar -> xField, yField; pie -> angleField; histogram -> binField; dualAxes -> xField, leftYField, leftChartType, rightYField, rightChartType; stock -> xField, yField (4 columns). Series/grouping uses colorField (combine with stack or group); seriesField is funnel-only.
